name: Team Bulbasaur: Hive Breaker & Solar Incineration
archetype: Fire coverage, 4x fighting wallbreaking, and sleep status control.
gym_duel_rationale: Kurt's 5v5 Gym battle requires targeted typing counters: Kingler/Primeape functions as the ultimate ace slayer, obliterating Kurt's 582 BST Blissey/Shuckle with 4x super-effective STAB Close Combat before it can stack Minimize evasion; Venusaur/Charizard melts Forretress/Cloyster with 4x Flamethrower and disables Lotad/Kingdra with accurate Sleep Powder; Alakazam/Weezing easily picks off Beedrill/Ariados with STAB Psychic; Gyarados/Arbok cuts physical Attack on entry with Intimidate; and Snorlax absorbs stray special attacks effortlessly with Rest.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid. STAB Flamethrower cleanly incinerates Forretress/Cloyster through its 4x Fire weakness and melts Beedrill/Ariados.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Drops physical Attack on entry. Glare applies reliable paralysis to cripple fast Bug/Dragon sweepers.
495 BST special sweeper with 118 SpA. STAB Psychic effortlessly OHKOs Beedrill/Ariados and bypasses physical bulk.
500 BST physical titan. Close Combat exploits Blissey/Shuckle's catastrophic 4x Fighting weakness to shatter Kurt's ace instantly.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs Dragon Pulse and special attacks with ease, recovering to full vitality with Rest and Sleep Talk.
High-Speed Flying scout. STAB Air Slash provides super-effective Flying coverage against wild bug species across Ilex Forest.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against bulky route encounters.
Discharge electrocutes Slowbro/Scizor and handles water encounters in Slowpoke Well.
High Jump Kick physical breaker capable of substituting into the active party for Fighting STAB.
